name: Forward Projection with Siddon's Algorithm
aliases: Ray Tracing (in context of forward projection)
definition: A forward projection method that computes the length of intersection between rays and voxels using Siddon's algorithm.
summary: Forward Projection with Siddon's Algorithm computes geometric ray-voxel intersection lengths to project volume data into sinogram bins, distinguishing itself by explicitly calculating these intersections rather than using iterative reconstruction or simplified binning approximations.
